name: tinystudio-io
description: TinyStudio public website: The Website Appraisal and the human-reviewed desk on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:headings && npm run test:sitemap && npm run test:worker && npm run test:ui && npm run test:contract && npm run test:viewport && npm run test:narrow-pages && npm run test:narrow
scripts.leads:list: wrangler d1 execute tinystudio_email_signups --remote --command "SELECT email, source, page_path, created_at, updated_at FROM email_signups ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100;"
scripts.leads:export: wrangler d1 execute tinystudio_email_signups --remote --command "SELECT email, source, page_path, created_at, updated_at FROM email_signups ORDER BY updated_at DESC;" --json
